title: External Cohort Validation Statistical Design and Estimands Specification for E13 (Source-Disjoint Cohort Generalization)

target_cohorts: Synthea Synthetic FHIR Longitudinal Cohort v3.0.0
MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo on FHIR v2.1.0

E13.title: External Cohort Generalizability & Source-Disjoint Task Validation
primary_research_questions: Does the GRWC exact-disclosure admission kernel generalize without schema modifications to externally authored clinical datasets (eICU, Synthea, MIMIC-IV, Diabetes 130) and disjoint assertion tasks?
Can state reconstruction achieve 100% parity (zero information loss) across multi-encounter longitudinal record sequences?
Does external fact retention achieve >= 98.0% accuracy under dual-annotator review protocol?
What are the inter-rater agreement statistics (Cohen's kappa and Krippendorff's alpha) across dual annotator review packets?

eicu.name: eICU Collaborative Research Database Demo v2.0.1
eicu.focus: ICU longitudinal offset events, vital signs, laboratory dynamics, and continuous vasoactive drug titrations (e.g. Norepinephrine wean/discontinuation).
eicu.temporal_representation: Relative minute offsets from ICU admission (anchor: icu_unit_admission; calendar dates marked UNAVAILABLE_NOT_ESTIMATED).

synthea.name: Synthea Synthetic FHIR Longitudinal Cohort v3.0.0
synthea.focus: Multi-encounter longitudinal patient histories, chronic disease staging (CKD progression), and Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT) titration.
synthea.temporal_representation: Multi-year outpatient/inpatient timeline offsets across FHIR Condition, MedicationRequest, and Observation resources.

mimic_on_fhir.name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo on FHIR v2.1.0
mimic_on_fhir.focus: Acute inpatient hospital stays, antibiotic escalation/de-escalation sequences, problem list transitions, and amended lab observations.
mimic_on_fhir.temporal_representation: Resource-level FHIR authoredOn, validityPeriod, and effectiveDateTime timestamps.

diabetes_130.name: Diabetes 130-US Hospitals Cohort v1.0.0
diabetes_130.focus: 10-year longitudinal diabetic encounter timelines, acute glycemic decompensation, inpatient oral-to-injectable insulin transitions, and 30-day readmissions.
diabetes_130.temporal_representation: Multi-encounter boundaries with intra-admission offsets and inter-encounter readmission intervals.

non_human_adjudication_transparency.red_team_rule: Model-based QA is strictly labeled as SYNTHETIC_MODEL_ADJUDICATION and ineligible for independent human clinical claim.
non_human_adjudication_transparency.rationale: Per GLHS claim budget policy (category INTERNAL_AGENT_ADJUDICATION), model-based reviewer panels are internal verification tools and must never be represented as human clinician adjudication.

primary.name: External Fact Retention Accuracy
primary.definition: Proportion of verified clinical facts retained without omission, distortion, or state corruption during GRWC state reconstruction across external tasks.
primary.aggregation: Sample proportion with Wilson score 95% confidence intervals.

primary.name: State Reconstruction Parity
primary.definition: Proportion of external patient timelines canonicalized into THSS snapshots achieving exact bit-for-bit parity with the reference latest valid offset resolver with zero information loss.
primary.aggregation: Sample proportion with 1-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson / Wilson lower bound.

secondary.name: False Positive Rate (FPR)
secondary.definition: Proportion of non-existent, hallucinated, or discontinued clinical entities improperly admitted into active persistent state during external task reconstruction.
secondary.aggregation: Sample proportion with Wilson score 95% confidence intervals.

secondary.name: False Negative Rate (FNR)
secondary.definition: Proportion of valid ground-truth active clinical entities omitted from reconstructed state during external task execution.
secondary.aggregation: Sample proportion with Wilson score 95% confidence intervals.

secondary.name: Inter-Rater Agreement — Cohen's Kappa
secondary.definition: Cohen's kappa coefficient measuring chance-corrected agreement between dual annotator ratings across rating categories (ACCURATE, MINOR_DISCREPANCY, INACCURATE).
secondary.aggregation: Point estimate with 95% bootstrap confidence interval (10,000 resamples).

secondary.name: Inter-Rater Reliability — Krippendorff's Alpha
secondary.definition: Krippendorff's alpha reliability coefficient for nominal ratings across dual annotator packets accounting for chance agreement.
secondary.aggregation: Point estimate with 95% bootstrap confidence interval (10,000 resamples).

statistical_methods.proportion_confidence_intervals: Wilson score interval for point estimates and confidence bounds at 95% confidence level.
statistical_methods.inter_rater_agreement: Cohen's kappa (chance-corrected agreement) and Krippendorff's alpha (nominal distance metric) evaluated over dual annotator rating pairs.
statistical_methods.bootstrap_resampling: 10,000 non-parametric bootstrap resamples to compute BCa confidence intervals for kappa and alpha.

fail_closed_criteria: Any attempt to cite model-based ratings as human clinician adjudication immediately halts validation and invalidates claim eligibility.
Any state corruption or unhandled schema failure during external task canonicalization fails invariant I10/I12.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Inaccessible or unparseable external task records are categorized as UNABLE_TO_VERIFY and counted as reconstruction failures (0.0% score).

reproducibility_and_sealing.checksum_rule: Raw result streams (results.jsonl), summary artifacts (summary.json, summary.md), validation records (validation.json), and protocol files must be cryptographically sealed in checksums.sha256 and seal.json.
